title: Microsoft SkillOpt Makes AI Smarter With One Text File #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitutorial #aitools
description:
Discover how Microsoft's SkillOpt boosts AI model accuracy up to 80% using just a single text file (SKILL.md) without expensive GPU retraining or weight fine-tuning.

Key Highlights:

Text-Space Training Loop: Runs an automated runner agent and optimizer agent to evaluate tasks and continuously refine instructions.

Zero Retraining Costs: Eliminates expensive fine-tuning pipelines while dramatically improving accuracy.

Open-Source Performance: Allowed small 4B open-source models like Qwen 3.5 to outperform closed models like GPT-5.2 on specialized benchmarks.

Dead Simple Setup: Clone the open-source GitHub repository and run the training script.
